Do you wish to use the orb on the pedestal?
entries.target:
这个基座似乎对你包里的东西有反应。经过测试后，你发现是包里的%s。
你想在这个基座上使用这个水晶球吗？

entries.source: It seems the slimes coming from the walls become stronger with time.
entries.target: 看来从墙壁中出现的软泥怪正在变得越来越强。

entries.source: #YELLOW_GREEN#One of the wall shakes for a moment and then turns into %s!
entries.target: #YELLOW_GREEN#一面墙壁颤抖了一会，变成了 %s！

entries.source: You have not finished your romantic time at the beach.
entries.target: 你还没享受完在海滩的浪漫时光。

entries.source: Enjoying a lovely day at the beach.
entries.target: 在海滩上度过美好的一天。

entries.source: #DARK_GREEN#As Melinda is about to die a powerful wave of blight emanates from her!
entries.target: #DARK_GREEN#在梅琳达临死的时候，一股枯萎能量从她的体内喷出！

entries.source: #DARK_GREEN#Melinda begins to glow with an eerie aura!
entries.target: #DARK_GREEN#梅琳达身边散发出诡异的光环！

entries.source: The sun of the Shandral star system.
One of the main planets of the Shandral system.
entries.target: 珊德拉星系的主要行星之一。

entries.source: One of the moons of Eyal.

entries.target: 通往最后的希望的传送门

entries.source: This portal seems to be connected with Last Hope; you could probably use it to go back.
entries.target: 这道传送门似乎通向最后的希望，你也许能通过它回去。

entries.source: Enter the portal back to Last Hope?
entries.target: 进入传送门，回到最后的希望？

entries.source: The traitor has been revealed, and he does not intend to let you escape to tell the tale.
entries.target: 叛徒的真面目已被揭露，他并不打算让你逃脱去讲述这个故事。

entries.source: and was neither found nor heard from again
entries.target: 并使其从此下落不明、杳无音讯

entries.source:
This is Tannen's construct, a HUGE golem in the rough shape of a dragon.
It is so huge that it blocks sight beyond it.
entries.target:
这是泰恩的构装体，一只巨大的龙形傀儡。
它如此庞大，遮蔽了它身后的视线。

entries.source: You cannot bring yourself to drop the %s
An athame, covered in blood runes. It radiates power.
entries.target: 一把刻满血色符文的仪式匕首，散发着强大的能量。

entries.source:
The orb projects images of distant places, some that seem not to be of this world, switching rapidly.
If used near a portal, it could probably activate it.
entries.target:
这个球体可以投射出远方的景象，并快速地切换着，有些景象甚至不属于这个世界。
如果你在传送门附近使用它，它也许能激活传送门。

entries.source: There is no portal to activate here.
entries.target: 这里没有可用的传送门。

entries.source: A paper scrap, left by Tannen.
The portal brought you to what seems to be a cell in the basement of the tower. You must escape!
entries.target: 传送门将你送到了一座高塔地下室中的牢房里。你必须逃离！

entries.source: As you climb up the steps, you see Tannen standing with his drolem, reading a scrap of parchment.  As he reads, his eyes grow wider, and he starts sweating and pacing back and forth.  When he reaches to stuff it in his pocket, he sees you and jumps back like a startled cat.  "No!  Not now!  You have no idea what's at stake!"  He retrieves a fistful of brightly-colored flasks from his robes, and his drolem's eyes glow as it springs to life, metal screeching in an impressive imitation of a roar.
entries.target: 当你爬上楼梯，你看到泰恩正和他的龙傀儡站在一起，手中拿着一张羊皮纸。在他阅读的时候，他的眼睛越睁越大，汗如雨下，不断来回踱步。当他攥起纸条试图放进口袋里的时候，他突然望见了你，如同一只受惊吓的猫一样向后跳了几步。“不！不是现在！你根本不懂，现在是生死攸关的时刻！”他从长袍中掏出一把色彩鲜艳的小瓶子，身旁的龙傀儡双眼亮起，随之活了过来，金属发出刺耳的尖啸，惟妙惟肖地模仿着咆哮。

entries.source: Everybody thought Telos dead and his spirit destroyed, but it seems he still lingers in his old place of power.
entries.target: 所有人都认为泰勒斯已经形神俱灭了，但现在看起来他似乎仍徘徊在他旧日的力量之所。

entries.source: and was savagely mutilated, a show of his rage towards all living things
entries.target: 并将其残忍肢解，以此宣泄他对一切生灵的怒火

entries.source: As the shade dissipates, you see no sign of the text entitled "Inverted and Reverted Probabilistic Fields". You should go back to Tannen.
entries.target: 当阴影消退，你没有找到任何题为《反转与复原概率场》的文本。你应该回去找泰恩。

entries.source: The bottom part of Telos' broken staff.
entries.target: 泰勒斯折断法杖的下半部。

entries.source: As you approach the tower you notice it is utterly destroyed, only the basement remaining.
entries.target: 当你靠近高塔时，你发现它已被彻底摧毁，只剩下地下室。
